task: FV2-035 — Flutter and web screen thumbnails live in the screen-sharing rail
summary: Screen-share thumbnails are presented in the stream-selection rail rather than participant cards. Flutter shows local and remote thumbnails in the screen viewer/ended-screen rails; web exposes its thumbnail rail in the connected voice room and keeps participant cards focused on identity and controls.

checks.name: Flutter rail test-first regression
checks.observation: Covers the local and remote image thumbnails, responsive card geometry, semantics, and placement below the video stage. Before implementation, the local choice fixture failed to compile because its dedicated constructor did not exist.

checks.name: Web voice-room regression
checks.observation: Asserts screen thumbnails are supplied through the room screen rail and absent from participant cards. The newly added test failed before implementation because the connected room had no screen rail.

checks.name: Web production build
checks.observation: Vue typecheck and Vite production build succeeded. Existing LiveKit dynamic-import and large-chunk warnings remain.
